label: Extractive summary: key sentences quoted from the article
key_points: The town opened a new reading room beside the public garden on Monday.
The reading room has 40 seats and a separate space for group activities.
Volunteers will lead weekly reading sessions for residents throughout the winter.
The council said the room would remain open during the evening twice a week.
Residents can borrow books and suggest titles for the next collection.
